subject: Post-demo: model recommendations, sample-capture & redaction plan
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Park <julia@jigsaw.ai>, Samuel Lee <samuel.lee@jigsaw.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-05-15T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: model recommendations, sample-capture & redaction plan

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier — great conversation. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can put together an eval that maps to your LLM assistant use cases (support triage + contract summarization).

TL;DR recommendations and asks:
- Recommended model candidates: redwood-7b-v1 (fast, cost-efficient baseline), redwood-13b-llm-v2 (higher-quality for longer documents), and a quantized 13b variant for on-prem testing.
- Benchmarks: I kicked off a quick eval dashboard for your account — link below. We'll run generation- and extractive-based metrics on the prompt set you share.
- Request: Please upload ~200 representative prompts/queries, prioritizing: 1) short triage questions, 2) multi-paragraph contract excerpts with redaction needs, 3) edge cases that fail today. See Drive folder link.
- Redaction guidance: mark any PII/PHI with [REDACT] tokens or use the provided redaction column in the spreadsheet. If you cannot redact, flag as "sensitive" and we'll handle review in our private sandbox.

Attachments: call-recording.mp3 (audio), sample_prompts_redactions.xlsx (template)
Links: Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcDEFjigsaw-sample-capture | Eval dashboard: https://app.redwood.ai/evals/benchmarks/DEAL-879

Proposed timeline:
- Tue (48h): Jigsaw uploads sample prompts and marks sensitive rows
- Fri (EOD): Redwood runs an initial model-fit pass and shares benchmark snapshot + a short decision matrix (latency vs. quality vs. cost)

Open questions from our side:
1) Any compliance constraints for storing raw prompt text in our private sandbox? (We can accept redacted-only or provide an S3 signed upload to your bucket.)
2) Who should own the sample curation internally? Point of contact for handoff?

Next steps: Julia — can you confirm who will own the sample upload and if redaction is possible? We'll treat any unredacted items as sensitive and put them in an access-limited folder.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

From: Julia Park <julia@jigsaw.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samuel Lee <samuel.lee@jigsaw.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-05-16T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: model recommendations, sample-capture & redaction plan

Thanks Kimberly — useful summary. A few clarifications:

- We'll aim to upload ~200 rows into your spreadsheet by end of day Thursday. I put Samuel on copy — he'll lead the data pull.
- For compliance: we can't send unredacted PHI outside our environment. We can either: (a) redact sensitive fields using your template, or (b) upload encrypted blobs to an S3 bucket in our AWS account and give you a temporary role to access them. Option (b) preferred for contract excerpts that we cannot alter.
- Two edge-case signals to call out: nested tables inside contracts (PDF->OCR noise) and language switching (EN/ES snippets). Please ensure your eval can handle scanned input.

Quick Q: The dashboard link you shared shows redwood-13b-llm-v2 performing well on summarization — any rough delta vs the 7b variant in terms of token cost we should plan for?

Julia
Head of Product | Jigsaw AI
julia@jigsaw.ai

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Park <julia@jigsaw.ai>, Samuel Lee <samuel.lee@jigsaw.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-05-18T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: model recommendations, sample-capture & redaction plan

Appreciate the answers, Julia — option (b) S3 upload with a temporary role is fine. I'll loop in our security contact if we need to formalize access.

Answers inline:
- Cost delta: ballpark (per-token) — redwood-7b-v1 ~0.6x cost of 13b-v2; throughput is significantly better on 7b (lower latency), but 13b-v2 reduces hallucination on long contract summarization by ~8–12% on our contract-qa benchmark. We'll include a cost/quality tradeoff table in Friday's snapshot.
- OCR/scanned docs: please flag rows as "scanned" and attach the original PDF in the S3 bucket. We'll run an OCR-normalization step prior to eval and include a note on OCR noise impact.

Deliverables we will provide after upload:
1) Baseline benchmark snapshot (generation metrics, rouge/qa F1, hallucination rate) for the two candidates + a quantized config for on-prem testing.
2) Prompt-level error log highlighting edge cases we couldn't fix via prompt engineering.
3) A short action plan for next 30 days: POC config, privacy review, and canary rollout guidance for Dedicated.

I'll create the temporary role and send the S3 instructions via a secure Doc in the next message.

—Kimberly

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Julia Park <julia@jigsaw.ai>, Samuel Lee <samuel.lee@jigsaw.ai>
Date: 2025-05-20T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: model recommendations, sample-capture & redaction plan

Internal note (adding a bit of operational detail for the team):

- Action items assigned:
  * Kimberly: create S3 role + secure instructions (by EOD 5/20) — blocking for Jigsaw upload.
  * Marissa: once samples are in, run the initial redwood-7b-v1 pass and produce the preliminary dashboard snapshot (due 5/23).
  * Ben: prepare the quantization test harness for on-prem run (need customer infra specs).

- Security: escalate to Security for an IFR (temporary role review). Kimberly, loop in security@redwood.ai when you create the role.
- Notes on redaction: ask Jigsaw to mark anything that contains full SSNs, bank account numbers, or full patient records as SENSITIVE and we will not persist raw text in hosted evals unless they give explicit approval.

I'll follow up with a short checklist that Marissa can use during the initial pass.

Thanks — ready to move once we confirm S3 access and sample upload.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
